resources.string: Personal fork of Telegram for Android.
Removes the gradient fade behind the header, input bar, bottom tabs and sheets.
Defaults are 40% intensity and 20% tint. Changes apply when a screen is redrawn, for example after reopening a chat.
Centered, floating chat header pill like iOS Telegram. Does not affect other screens.
Move avatar to the menu button
Put the avatar in the menu slot: tap for the profile, long-press for the chat menu.
Show the number of unread chats on the back button in a chat.
Auto-scrolls long chat header titles and subtitles when they do not fit horizontally.
Hold emoji to show or hide
Controls the send-as avatar in the input bar. With the hold option, the last state is remembered for all chats.
